projects.title: Executive Financial KPI Dashboard
projects.tagline: A boardroom-ready view of every metric that matters.
projects.problem: A finance team was spending 4 days a month assembling executive reports — pulling numbers from 6 sources, formatting manually, and emailing static PDFs that were stale the moment they were sent.
projects.solution: I built a single executive command center that consolidates Revenue, Profit, EBITDA, Cash Flow, and 14 supporting KPIs. Dynamic filters by region, department, quarter, and product category. One refresh button updates the entire model.
projects.outcome: Monthly reporting cycle compressed from 4 days to 30 minutes. CFO now reviews live numbers, not last week's snapshot.
features: 12 executive KPI cards with YoY/MoM comparison
Revenue vs Expense trend with waterfall analysis

projects.title: Power Query ETL Pipeline
projects.tagline: Three messy sources in. One clean executive dashboard out.
projects.problem: Client received daily data from a CSV sales export, an ERP inventory dump, and a CRM customer file — all in different formats, with inconsistent dates, duplicate records, and missing values. Cleaning took 3 hours per day.
projects.solution: End-to-end Power Query ETL: ingest from three sources, apply 12 transformation steps (deduplication, type coercion, lookup merges, format standardization), output a single master analytics-ready data model.
projects.outcome: 3 hours of manual work → 12 seconds of refresh. Zero data entry errors since deployment.

projects.title: DataCleanerPro — Custom Excel Ribbon Tool
projects.tagline: Not a spreadsheet. A productivity product built into Excel.
projects.problem: Analysts and admin teams burn hours every week on the same manual data hygiene — fixing casing, trimming spaces, standardizing phone numbers and dates, validating emails, killing duplicates, reformatting currency. Every dataset, every week, by hand. Error-prone, soul-crushing, and impossible to scale.
projects.solution: DataCleanerPro is a custom Excel ribbon tab — it installs alongside Home, Insert and Data, exactly like an enterprise add-in. 60+ one-click commands grouped into Text Casing, Trim & Clean, Numbers & INR, Dates, Emails, Phone Numbers, Duplicates, Standardization, Sheet Utilities, and a one-click Data Quality Report. Messy data in, audit-clean data out, in seconds.
projects.outcome: What took an analyst 2–3 hours per dataset now takes under 60 seconds. Zero manual cleaning errors. The same tool works on every file, forever — and it's fully customizable to any team's workflow.
features: Custom ribbon tab — installs like an enterprise add-in
Text Casing: Upper, Lower, Proper, Sentence
Trim & Clean: spaces, non-print & special characters, blank flagging
Numbers & INR: ₹ format, Lakhs, percentage, rounding, text-to-number
Date Tools: DD-MMM-YYYY, text-to-date, invalid-date flagging
Email & Phone utilities: validate, +91 formatting, 10-digit normalization
Duplicate management: highlight, remove, count, prevent
Standardization: gender, Yes/No, name splitting, outlier flagging
Utilities: freeze header, autofit, print area, CSV export
projects.industry: Cross-industry · Finance / HR / MIS / CRM / Ops
projects.customBuildNote: DataCleanerPro is one example. I build ribbon-integrated tools tailored to any team's workflow — finance reconciliation, HR onboarding, CRM hygiene, MIS automation, QA validation. Your repetitive process becomes a one-click button on your own custom Excel tab.

projects.title: CRM Sales Command Center
projects.tagline: An Excel-native CRM for teams who outgrew spreadsheets but not their budget.
projects.problem: A 12-person sales team was managing 3,800+ leads across 14 different spreadsheets — no pipeline visibility, no follow-up discipline, and no idea what was actually working.
projects.solution: Single-workbook CRM with pipeline funnel, follow-up command center, lead source attribution, deal-stage value tracking, and rep performance leaderboard. Built-in alerts for overdue follow-ups.
projects.outcome: Win rate increased from 14% to 22% in the first quarter. Sales team reports daily standup directly from the dashboard.

projects.title: Sales & Revenue Growth Dashboard
projects.tagline: Track revenue, growth %, and conversion in one view.
projects.problem: Sales leadership wanted YoY growth, MoM trends, regional performance, and product-mix contribution in a single screen — but their existing reports were 7 different PDFs.
projects.solution: Unified growth dashboard with revenue trend, target-vs-achievement gauges, regional heatmap (India), top-10 customer ranking, repeat vs new customer split, and sales rep performance.
projects.outcome: Weekly sales review meetings cut from 90 min to 25 min. Leadership now drills into outliers in real-time.

projects.title: Strategic Financial Model
projects.tagline: CFO intelligence system with scenario engine and forecasting.
projects.problem: A growth-stage company needed an investor-grade financial model for their Series A — P&L, scenarios, cash flow, valuation, and forecasting on a rolling 12-month basis.
projects.solution: Modular financial model with separate P&L, budget planner, forecasting engine (rolling 12), scenario analysis (5 scenarios), DCF valuation model, cash flow projection, and ratio intelligence engine.
projects.outcome: Closed Series A in 4 months. Model became the company's permanent financial operating system.

projects.title: Inventory & Supply Chain Dashboard
projects.tagline: Stockouts cost money. This dashboard prevents them.
projects.problem: A distributor with 1,200+ SKUs across 4 warehouses was losing 12% of monthly revenue to stockouts and another 8% to overstock on slow-moving inventory.
projects.solution: Inventory command center with reorder point automation, ABC classification, ageing analysis, supplier OTD scorecard, demand forecasting, and warehouse utilization tracking.
projects.outcome: Stockout rate dropped 68% in 90 days. Inventory carrying cost reduced by 14%.

projects.title: HR Workforce Analytics Dashboard
projects.problem: An HR team managing 1,200+ employees had no visibility into attrition risk, training ROI, or compensation distribution — every report took 2 weeks to compile.
projects.solution: Workforce intelligence dashboard covering talent acquisition funnel, attrition trend by department, attrition risk heatmap, performance distribution, training analytics, and compensation breakdown.
projects.outcome: Identified 18 high-risk employees ahead of resignation. Reduced attrition by 22% over 6 months.

projects.title: Customer Intelligence Dashboard
projects.tagline: RFM segmentation, churn prediction, and cohort retention.
projects.problem: A B2B SaaS company couldn't tell which customers were about to churn or which were their actual best segment — until I rebuilt their analytics layer.
projects.solution: Customer intelligence dashboard with RFM segmentation matrix, churn risk distribution, churn intelligence summary, cohort retention matrix, customer lifecycle journey, and revenue contribution by segment.
projects.outcome: Reactivation campaigns increased revenue by $1.94M in 12 months by targeting predicted churners.

projects.title: Marketing Campaign Analytics
projects.tagline: ROAS, CAC, channel attribution — across every campaign.
projects.problem: Marketing team running paid campaigns across 7 channels had no unified view of ROAS, CAC, or which campaigns actually drove revenue versus just clicks.
projects.solution: Multi-channel campaign analytics dashboard with spend vs revenue trend, channel performance ranking, audience segment performance, device performance, budget variance waterfall, and engagement analytics.
projects.outcome: Reallocated 38% of budget away from underperforming channels. ROAS improved 20.4% in one quarter.

projects.title: KPI Performance Control Tower
projects.tagline: Traffic-light KPI scoreboard for cross-functional teams.
projects.problem: An ops director needed an at-a-glance view of every department's KPI status — financial, sales, operations, HR — without diving into 8 separate spreadsheets.
projects.solution: Balanced-scorecard KPI control tower with overall performance index gauge, traffic-light matrix (department × KPI category), top performer leaderboard, initiative tracker, and alerts & exceptions.
projects.outcome: Monthly leadership reviews now run from a single screen. Underperforming KPIs flagged automatically.

projects.title: Project Portfolio Gantt Dashboard
projects.tagline: Gantt timelines, resource heatmaps, and risk matrices.
projects.problem: A PMO managing 32 active projects across 4 departments had no real portfolio view — just individual project plans with no rollup.
projects.solution: Project portfolio command center with Gantt timeline, resource utilization heatmap, risk heatmap (impact × probability), budget variance, schedule variance gauges, and task completion funnel.
projects.outcome: Identified 4 at-risk projects 6 weeks earlier than the previous system. Budget variance improved 8.3%.

projects.title: HR Attendance Management System
projects.tagline: Drop-in attendance, leave, and shift management workbook.
projects.problem: Small businesses without an HRMS were tracking attendance in unstructured spreadsheets — leading to payroll errors, leave disputes, and zero analytics.
projects.solution: Self-contained HR attendance template with attendance entry, leave management, shift schedule, attendance tracker, monthly heatmap, and 9 supporting analytics views.
projects.outcome: Deployed to 8 client teams. Payroll-related disputes dropped to zero across all deployments.

projects.title: Automated Invoice & Billing Generator
projects.tagline: Generate, preview, and email invoices in 10 seconds.
projects.problem: A consultancy was manually creating invoices in Word every time — copying client details, calculating taxes, and losing 4+ hours per week to billing admin.
projects.solution: One-click invoice generator: select client from master, add line items, auto-calculates GST/discounts/totals, generates PDF preview, saves to invoice history, and emails via VBA.
projects.outcome: Billing time reduced from 4 hours/week to 12 minutes/week. Zero invoice errors in 6 months.

projects.title: Expense Reimbursement System
projects.tagline: From submission to payout — every step automated.
projects.problem: Finance team was processing 128+ expense claims per month manually — submission via email, approval via more email, reimbursement tracked in yet another spreadsheet.
projects.solution: Expense reimbursement management system with claim submission form, approval workflow, payment tracking, policy compliance scoring, and full reporting layer.
projects.outcome: Claim processing time reduced from 8 days to 2.6 days. Policy compliance score improved to 92.45%.

projects.title: Sales Commission Calculator
projects.tagline: Commission rules engine with accelerators and bonuses.
projects.problem: A sales-driven company was calculating commissions manually for 50+ reps with tiered rates, accelerators, retention bonuses, and quarterly performance bonuses — 3 days of payroll work, full of errors.
projects.solution: Commission calculator with slab rules engine, accelerator logic, bonus rules (retention, top performer, campaign), payout statement generator, and forecasted commission projections.
projects.outcome: Commission processing time cut from 3 days to 45 minutes. Zero disputed payouts in 9 months.

projects.title: Monthly Budget vs Actual Tracker
projects.tagline: Plan, track, control, and analyze — month after month.
projects.problem: An ops team was setting monthly budgets but had no way to track variance until the month ended — by which time corrective action was too late.
projects.solution: Budget vs actual tracker with rolling variance analysis, waterfall variance visualization, forecast & runway calculator, department-wise utilization, alerts on overspend, and executive insights panel.
projects.outcome: Spotted overspending early in 3 of 6 departments. Cash runway visibility expanded from 1 to 2.35 months ahead.
